spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §3 (framing: length > 65536 -> Error(401)+Close(401), before any allocation)
docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §10 (control frame size 64 KiB hard cap)
description: Framing violation: a length prefix declaring 65537 bytes — one over the 64 KiB cap — is refused on the prefix alone, before any body bytes are read or allocated.

steps.note: Declares 65537 body bytes; no body is sent at all — the receiver must reject on the prefix.

assertions: 65536 is the hard cap and only a length STRICTLY greater is a violation — see limits/frame-cap-65536-accepted for the accepted boundary.
The rejection must happen before allocation (spec §3): a receiver that buffers first and checks later violates the spec.
